scripts.build:api: npm run db:generate && npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @sim-dashboard/api
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build -w @sim-dashboard/admin
scripts.dev: npm run build:api && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,admin,api,types "npm run dev -w @sim-dashboard/shared" "npm run dev -w @sim-dashboard/admin" "npm run dev -w @sim-dashboard/api" "npm run dev:types -w @sim-dashboard/api"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names admin,api "npm run start -w @sim-dashboard/admin" "npm run start -w @sim-dashboard/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
